flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code in the six repos. Nearest (not a match): ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase/OcmsCourtCase.java.
note: Story status is User Story Removed; the verdict stays Removed. There is no form, entity, endpoint, upload or State Courts submission for a summon-witness application. The nearest is ocms_court_case (notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason) used by the CAS integration, which is not a witness application. Searched synonyms witness, summon witness, State Courts, court mention, section of law, investigation officer, SummonWit, ocms_summon, ocms_court_mention across the six repos (UI and API, stale cronservice ignored): no hit related to a summon-witness application.

steps.step: Officer indicates the Section of Law
steps.detail: No Section of Law field or dropdown (synonyms: section_of_law, sectionOfLaw, law section) in UI or API.

steps.step: Officer enters investigation officer and applicant details
steps.detail: No investigation officer / applicant form for an application (synonyms: investigation_officer, IO, applicant). witness_po_id in ocmsadminui/src/utils/mapping/NoticeUPL.ts:395 is a UPL field, not this.

steps.step: Officer enters the court mention details
steps.detail: No court mention input for an application. Only search filters court_mention_date_start/end exist (ocmsadminui/src/pages/NoticeSearch/form/NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:318), which are read filters, not data entry.
No witness form, entity or table (synonyms: witness, witness particulars) in the six repos.
No document upload for a witness application. The XLSX upload in Notice Search (NoticeSearchForm.tsx:181) is only for a list of notice numbers, not application documents.

steps.step: OCMS submits the details and documents to State Courts
steps.detail: No integration/SFTP/API to State Courts for witness applications in ocmsadminprivateapi/src, ocmsadminapi, thirdpartyapi. The only court-side entry is the inbound CAS endpoint set (CasIntegrationController), which does not send applications out. SFTP partner: cannot verify from repo.
